hypothesis: Training-only cointegrated log-price residuals may revert after costs. Distinct economic hypothesis from prior directional trends; no promise of profit.

formation.multiple_testing: BH at5percent across both directions of all declared pairs within each formation; report cumulative tests across formations. Unknown failed tests remain unknown and nonadmissible.
formation.economic_gate_definition: 2*training residual sigma/(1+beta) must exceed twice the stress roundtrip cost per unit gross. Registered before formation statistics; no return ranking.
formation.matching: Greedy ascending worst two-direction q, then half-life, then lexical pair; disjoint symbols. No realised future-return ranking.

signal.cost_hurdle: Estimated convergence return per unit gross abs(z)*training_sigma/(1+beta) must exceed max(2*stress_roundtrip_cost, stress_roundtrip_cost+nonnegative7dayfundingcost using last5complete daily observations). Both cost cases share the stress15bps gate; no future funding projection.

execution: Two perpetual legs submitted from prior close and completed-hour volume. Independent next5m fills; any unequal fill fraction triggers next-interval close of filled inventory, never free atomic cancellation. Partial exits persist and symbols remain owned until both legs flat. One pair campaign, including failed one-leg attempts, counts as one lifecycle; never count both legs as independent wins. Funding at actual events, entry/exit fees and adverse slippage, marked openPnL and exit reserve included.
model_ownership: Rolling refits use only closed past days; a new formation/model ID requires old pair campaign to close before reuse of either symbol. Fixed model coefficients/mu/sigma never recenter on future data. No highwater or account halt reset.
budget: At most6screen+12diagnostic+8capacity=26accounts. Both formation variants are preregistered; no parameter grid or forced relaxation if no eligible pairs. Gate formation before building account interpretations.
statistical_scope: Both-direction EG on log daily prices, rank1 Johansen confirmation, OLS beta and residual statistics; exploratory BH assumes dependence conditions and does not erase historical search. Data40contemporary names has survivorship bias; no new independentOOS.
